login.headline: Everything your pipeline needs, in one place.
login.subhead: Leads, listings, viewings, deals and commissions — built for how agencies actually work, from first enquiry to closed deal.
login.signInSubtitle: Sign in to your agency workspace

signup.headline: Set up your agency's workspace in under a minute.
signup.subhead: No sales call, no setup fee — pick your currency, invite your team, and start running your pipeline today.
signup.title: Create your agency workspace
signup.subtitle: Set up Kaya for your agency in under a minute — no sales call required.
signup.planHint: You start on the Starter plan, free to try — upgrade any time from Settings.

hero.headline: Sell property. Collect rent. Run your whole agency from one place.
hero.subhead: Leads, listings, deals, rent and landlord payouts in one system built for Kenya: M-Pesa and WhatsApp ready, priced in your own currency, and clear about what it automates and what it leaves to you.
hero.noCard: No credit card required to try it.

capabilities.currency: Priced and shown in your currency
capabilities.roles: Role-based access for every team member

closingCta.headline: Give your team one place to run the pipeline
closingCta.subhead: Try Kaya free, or talk to us first — we'll walk your team through it over a call.

forgot.headline: Locked out? We'll get you back in.
forgot.subhead: Enter your work email and we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a reset link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Use at least 8 characters.
